findings.evidence: `EnergyFormContinuity.lean:43` declares `variable {X n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]`, while `UniformEllipticity.lean:97` has `omit [DecidableEq n] in` before `noncomputable def matrixBilinearForm`; the new principal declarations at lines 48, 63, 153, 180, and 208 have no corresponding omit.
findings.fix: Add `omit [DecidableEq n] in` to the principal-matrix declarations, proving linearity without relying on DecidableEq-specialized helper lemmas if necessary.
findings.issue: `matrixBilinearFormLinear` and its wrappers (`matrixBilinearFormLinear_apply`, `continuous_matrixBilinearForm`, `Continuous.matrixBilinearForm`, `ContinuousOn.matrixBilinearForm`) inherit `[DecidableEq n]` even though the underlying principal form does not need it.

summary: The coefficient-continuity API is at the intended finite-dimensional PDE level, but the principal-matrix continuity declarations carry an unnecessary `DecidableEq n` assumption.
